newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures turn slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures turn slightly lower.

text.p: July 7 - U.S. stock index futures turned mostly lower, cutting early gains. Traders note mild profit-taking. Earlier, Sept S&P 500 hit new record high at 932.25, but edged through support at 927.50. One trader noted a brokerage house sale of 1,000 Sept S&Ps, but says overall trade was very quiet.
